verdict.rationale: Box offers AI features (the Box AI API, AI agents, and a hosted MCP server), so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a training-exclusion control, or a contractual no-training policy. The only related material is generic marketing, such as "content stays protected" and "enterprise permissions intact", which is an adjacent security claim and not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
